strings.打开聊天历史，可在终端续接: Open chat history and continue in the terminal
strings.打开聊天历史，CLI尚未安装: Open chat history; CLI is not installed
strings.查看同步历史，回复请在对应终端输入: View synced history; reply in the corresponding terminal
strings.终端已结束回合会同步，退出后可回原生聊天发送: Completed terminal turns sync to chat; exit to resume native chat
strings.返回同步历史，继续回复请使用对应终端: Return to synced history; continue replying in the terminal
strings.在终端输入 /exit 退出后返回: Type /exit in the terminal before returning
strings.在终端中继续此会话，输入内容保留为草稿: Continue in the terminal; text here is kept as a draft
strings.同项目下尚无其他会话: No other chats in this project
strings.运行中的 Codex 会立即接收消息，空闲会话将在下一回合接收。: Messages go to the active Codex turn, or wait for the next turn in an idle chat.
strings.请输入有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address
strings.页面已变化，请重新选择元素: The page changed. Pick the element again.
strings.请选择表单或嵌入内容之外的元素: Pick an element outside form fields and embedded content.
strings.未能定位页面元素: Could not locate the page element.
strings.输入网址或 localhost 地址: Enter a URL or localhost address
strings.请在可写工作区窗口打开浏览器: Open the browser in the writable workspace window
strings.搜索项目、工作树、会话或终端: Search projects, worktrees, chats or terminals
strings.打开 EX Agent Code 查看活动: Open EX Agent Code to view activity
strings.系统通知未送达，请检查通知权限: Notification delivery failed. Check system permissions.
strings.拖到边缘拆分，拖到中央合并: Drag to an edge to split or to the center to group tabs
strings.GitHub、Linear 或 Jira 任务链接: GitHub, Linear, or Jira task URL
strings.请输入有效的 PR 或工单链接。: Enter a valid pull request or issue URL.
strings.未能保存关联。: Could not save the task link.
strings.请先在项目中添加工作区。: Add a workspace to a project first.
strings.无法打开任务链接。: Could not open the task URL.
strings.请配置 LINEAR_API_KEY。: Set LINEAR_API_KEY to read this issue.
strings.访问被拒绝，请检查任务读取权限。: Access denied. Check issue read access.
strings.未找到任务或没有读取权限。: Issue not found or access denied.
strings.每个工作区最多关联 128 条任务。: A workspace supports up to 128 linked tasks.
strings.请先配置会话运行账号: Configure an agent account for this chat first
strings.批注未保存，请检查工作区或批注数量。: Comment could not be saved. Check the workspace and the 128-comment limit.
strings.文件状态已变化，请刷新后重试。: File state changed. Refresh and try again.
strings.操作超时，请核对仓库状态。: Operation timed out. Check the repository state.
strings.暂存内容已变化，请重新审阅后提交。: Staged changes have changed. Reopen the commit review.
strings.暂存区过大，无法完整审阅。: Staged changes exceed the review limit.
strings.暂存区包含无法显示的文件名。: The index contains a filename that cannot be displayed.
strings.当前分支已变更或处于分离状态，请刷新。: Branch changed or HEAD is detached. Refresh the panel.
strings.只能操作工作区内的单个文件。: Select a single file inside the workspace.
strings.此文件在当前范围没有差异。: This file has no changes in this scope.
strings.当前工作区中无法定位此文件。: File not available in this workspace.
strings.此文件超出文件树显示范围。: File exceeds the file tree display limits.
strings.未跟踪文件超过 8 MiB 预览上限。: Untracked file exceeds the 8 MiB preview limit.
strings.此条目没有可显示的差异。: No diff to display for this entry.
strings.可访问文件和网络，执行时无需审批。: Access files and the network without approval.
strings.允许修改当前工作区中的文件。: Allow changes to files in this workspace.
strings.写入文件前，请先绑定工作区。: Link a workspace before writing files.
strings.随下条消息发送所选历史: Include selected history with next message
strings.首次运行从新输入开始；续接线程时沿用已有上下文。: New runs start with your message. Resumed threads keep their context.
strings.可将修改保存到原文件，或保留恢复草稿以便下次继续。: Save changes to your files, or keep recovery drafts to continue later.
strings.当前编辑内容会写入原路径，缺失文件会重建。: Write your edits to the original path. A missing file will be recreated.
strings.磁盘版本将替换当前编辑内容，撤销记录会重置。: Replace your edits with the disk version and reset undo history.
strings.恢复草稿目录不可写，请保存原文件后退出。: Recovery drafts cannot be written. Save the files before quitting.
strings.恢复草稿写入失败，请及时保存原文件。: Recovery draft could not be saved. Save your file.
strings.磁盘文件已变更，请选择重新载入或覆盖保存。: The file changed on disk. Reload it or choose overwrite.
strings.磁盘版本已变化，已阻止覆盖。: The disk version changed. Overwriting was blocked.
strings.文件已移除、不可读取或路径发生变化，编辑内容已保留。: The file was removed, cannot be read, or its path changed. Your edits are preserved.
strings.滚轮缩放 · 拖动平移 · 双击切换比例: Scroll to zoom · Drag to pan · Double-click to toggle scale
strings.Markdown 超过 128 Ki 字符预览限制，请使用源码视图。: Markdown exceeds the 128 Ki-character preview limit. Use the source view.
strings.个单元格 · 只读，不执行内核: cells · Read only, no kernel execution
strings.本地渲染 · 禁用网络与交互脚本: Local rendering · Network and interactive scripts disabled
strings.静态预览 · 禁用脚本、表单提交与网络: Static preview · Scripts, forms and network disabled
strings.活动 HTML / SVG / JavaScript 输出已禁用: Active HTML / SVG / JavaScript output disabled
strings.文件不在当前工作区中。: The file is outside the current workspace.
strings.文件无法读取或超过查看器大小限制。: Cannot read file or viewer size limit exceeded.
strings.文件读取期间超过大小限制。: The file exceeded the size limit while reading.
strings.查看器不支持此文件。: No viewer is available for this file.
strings.文件超过此查看器的大小限制。: The file exceeds this viewer’s size limit.
strings.PDF 无法读取、已加密或超过 2000 页限制。: Cannot read PDF: invalid, encrypted, or more than 2000 pages.
strings.表格须为 UTF-8 文本。: The table must be UTF-8 text.
strings.表格存在未闭合的引号。: An unclosed quoted field was found.
strings.表格超过 100000 行、1000 列、200万单元格或单元格 64 Ki 字: Table exceeds 100000 rows, 1000 columns, 2 million cells, or 64 Ki characters per cell.
strings.仅支持格式完整的 nbformat 4 Notebook。: Only valid nbformat 4 notebooks are supported.
strings.Notebook 单元格源码超过 256 Ki 字符限制。: Notebook cell source exceeds 256 Ki characters.
strings.单元格文本输出超过 512 Ki 字符限制。: Cell text output exceeds 512 Ki characters.
strings.图片输出无效或超过预览资源限制: Invalid image output or preview resource limit exceeded
strings.文件读取失败，未发布不完整内容。: File read failed. Incomplete content was not published.
strings.当前工作区不在 Git 仓库中。: This workspace is outside a Git repository.
strings.变更清单仅显示可预览的前一部分。: Only the first previewable changes are shown.
strings.此条目无法预览文件差异。: A file diff is unavailable for this entry.
strings.差异过长，仅显示开头部分。: Showing the beginning of this large diff.
strings.接收实例 ID（跨实例派发时填写）: Recipient instance ID for cross-instance tasks
strings.审计存储不可用或已满：新增授权将被阻止，仍可撤销共享。: Audit storage is unavailable or full. New access is blocked; revocation remains available.
strings.将撤销此会话的全部共享设备和待配对邀请，普通移动授权及其他会话不受影响。: Revoke shared devices and pending invitations for this chat. Other chats and regular mobile access remain unchanged.
strings.停止共享未完成，请刷新状态后核对。: Sharing could not be stopped. Refresh and check its current state.
strings.选择包含多个 Git 仓库的父目录。仅登记直接子仓库，不复制文件或执行初始化脚本: Choose a parent folder containing Git repositories. Direct child repositories are registered without copying files or running setup hooks.
strings.Agent 与文件树使用父目录，Git 操作使用任务来源仓库。多个文件夹工作区共: The agent and file tree use the parent folder. Git operations use the task source repository. Folder workspaces share actual files; create a task worktree in a child repository for an isolated branch.
strings.此文件不属于当前任务来源仓库: This file is outside the task source repository
strings.移除只解除成员关系，项目、仓库和会话继续保留。: Removing a member only unlinks it. Projects, repositories and chats are kept.
strings.成员将转为独立项目，已有会话与工作树保持原归属。: The member becomes an independent project. Chats and worktrees keep their ownership.
strings.没有可替代的仓库。可先取消，再删除项目组并保留全部工作区。: No replacement repository is available. Cancel and delete the group to keep all workspaces.
strings.仅删除分组关系。成员转为独立项目；组内工作区和会话保留为独立项目。仓库文件、分支: Only the grouping is deleted. Members become independent projects; group workspaces and chats are kept in an independent project. Repository files, branches and attachments are kept.
strings.私有 env 文件绝对路径；留空使用启动环境: Absolute private env-file path; leave empty to use the launch environment
strings.使用 Responses API；文件读写逐项审批，不提供终端执行。请填写模型: Uses the Responses API. Each file operation requires approval. Terminal execution is unavailable. Enter a model ID.
strings.文件工具每次都需审批；仅允许当前工作区，不支持命令执行。: Each file operation requires approval and is limited to the current workspace. Commands are unavailable.
strings.切换仅从下一轮生效，不会中断或重放当前任务。: Changes apply from the next turn without interrupting or replaying this task.
strings.选择下一轮使用的账号与模型。: Select the account and model for the next turn.
strings.新一轮遇限额时自动选择已验证的候选账号: Select a verified fallback account for new turns when limits are reached
strings.只选择同引擎、模型相容且已验证的账号；不重试已发送的消息。Token 为已收到的: Only verified accounts with the same engine and compatible model are selected. Sent messages are never retried. Tokens reflect received run snapshots, not charges; unknown plans and missing usage are not estimated.
strings.默认模型（可在使用时修改）: Default model (can be changed when selected)
strings.计费范围标识（可选，同范围不互相切换）: Billing scope (optional; same scope is excluded from fallback)
strings.使用独立私有登录目录，创建后点击登录所选账号。: Uses an isolated private sign-in directory. Create it, then sign in to the selected account.
strings.这里只保存文件路径，不保存密钥；新账号先手动发送一次完成核验。: Only the file path is stored, not the key. Verify a new account with a manual send first.
strings.统计容量已满：这里只显示已保留的上报记录，完整快照仍保存在对应聊天。: Usage capacity reached: only retained reports are summarized here. Full snapshots remain in their chats.
